current_date: July 2026 (page header 'July 2026'; council page: 'As of July 1, 2026 ... will be using an updated local list')
current_evidence: The Validation requirements page says the updated local list is used from 1 July 2026. It links download page 2277, whose only file is this PDF (file 2857), and the PDF is headed 'July 2026'.

issues.detail: Grokbot captured about 10 items, but Table 2 of the source has 42 local requirements. Missing are: Air Quality Assessment (major, polluting or traffic-generating development, in or next to an AQMA); Archaeological Desktop Assessment; Circular Economy Statement (major, KMWLP CSW3); Daylight/Sunlight Assessment (major); Draft Biodiversity Net Gain Plan; Economic Statement (major, or loss of employment); Energy Statement (major); Financial Viability Assessment (major schemes not meeting obligations); Flood Risk Assessment (Flood Zones 2/3, sites over 1ha in Zone 1, near water features, critical drainage areas); Foul Sewage and Surface Water Drainage Strategy; Gassing Landfill Site Assessment (within 50m of landfill); Land Contamination Assessment; Landscape and Views Impact Assessment (Green Belt openness, views, high buildings); Lighting Assessment; Minerals Assessment (Mineral Safeguarding Areas); Noise and/or Vibration Impact Assessment; Noise Insulation Details (HMO adjoining a single-family dwelling); Open Space Assessment; Planning Statement (major, incl. Green Belt VSC); Refuse and Recycling Storage; Sustainable Drainage Strategy (major, Source Protection Zones, increased hard surfacing); Topographical Survey / Levels (sloping sites); Bluewater Retail or Leisure Impact Assessment (over 2,500 sqm); Travel Plan and Active Travel Statement; Tree Survey and Arboricultural Implications Report (trees or hedgerows affected, within 30m of ancient woodland or veteran trees); Utilities Statement (major); Ventilation/Extraction Statement (restaurants, cafes, takeaways); Water Efficiency Statement (all new dwellings).
issues.evidence: Table 2 Local requirements, e.g. 'Water Efficiency Statement ... M3 ... All schemes creating new dwellings'

issues.detail: Householder and Listed building consent are recorded as '(none)', but the source applies local requirements to both. A Heritage Statement is required for Listed Building Consent and for any application in a Conservation Area or affecting the setting of a Listed Building or Scheduled Monument. A Structural Survey and Rebuilding Method Statement is required for Listed Building Consent and demolition of listed buildings. Householder schemes can also trigger Tree Survey, Flood Risk Assessment (Flood Zones 2/3), Street Scene Drawings, Topographical Survey / levels and Archaeological Assessment.
issues.evidence: Heritage Statement: 'Applications in Conservation Areas or affecting the setting of a Listed Building or Scheduled Monument; Listed Building Consent'

issues.detail: The Habitat Regulations Screening / Appropriate Assessment item quotes only the secondary trigger (more than 15 dwellings 6-10km from the North Kent SPAs/Ramsar sites). It omits the main trigger, ALL residential development within 6km, which catches single new dwellings. The excerpt is also garbled ('Residential developments of Assessment (shadow) Regulations 2017').
issues.evidence: 'All residential development within 6km of North Kent SPAs and Ramsar sites; residential over 15 dwellings within 6-10km'

issues.detail: The 'Housing mix / dwelling standards' trigger and the 'Drawing / document standards' tab_item are both the same garbled run of three table rows: Residential Space Standards Statement, Scale Bar and Street Scene Drawings. The real requirement is a Residential Space Standards Statement (NDSS and M4(2)/M4(3)) for all schemes creating new dwellings, using the council's template.
issues.evidence: Residential Space Standards Statement: 'All schemes creating new dwellings' (template linked from the validation page)

issues.detail: Other triggers are cut off or garbled. The Retail row ('be main town centre uses outside of the network of Retail centres must also be accompanied by a full retail impact assessment') drops the threshold: a sequential test for net gains in main town centre uses outside centres, and a full impact assessment at 280 sqm or more. The Parking row mixes two table columns; the source requirement is a Parking Management Strategy for well-served sites proposing reduced parking. Transport Statement/Assessment gives only the smaller-development line and omits that a TA is usually required for major schemes. The Affordable Housing excerpt is cut off ('all rented affordable hou'). The Site levels row is the fragment 'where final ground levels are unclear.', which belongs to Street Scene Drawings; the real levels requirement is a Topographical Survey for sites with differing, undulating or sloping ground.
issues.evidence: Town Centre Uses: Retail Sequential Test and Retail Impact Assessment (M18) - 280sqm+ requires full retail impact assessment

issues.detail: The Biodiversity Metric is placed only under Outline, because the text mentions 'indicative if outline'. The source requires it for all applications not exempt from the statutory biodiversity gain condition, so it covers Full applications too. The Draft BNG Plan is not captured at all.
issues.evidence: 'Applications that are not exempt from the requirement for a biodiversity gain condition under Schedule 7A'

issues.detail: Every Full planning row is marked 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. Examples are Affordable Housing, CIL form, Retail, Street scene and Transport. The source table has no application-type column. Items such as Street Scene Drawings, Tree Survey and CIL (any CIL-liable development, including householder extensions over 100 sqm) also apply to other application types.
issues.evidence: Table 2 column: 'Types of application that may require this information' describes development types, not application types

issues.detail: The only 'Drawing / document standards' tab_item is a garbled concatenation of several table cells: NDSS, Scale bar and Street Scene. It is not a coherent standard or requirement.
issues.evidence: 'NDSS and M4(2) or(3) and M8 Scale bar Adopted Dartford Local Plan Policy M1 All drawings that are to scale ... Street Scene Drawings ...'

issues.detail: The workbook's 'Req. items' count of 10 greatly understates the source, which has 42 local requirements in Table 2.
issues.evidence: Table 2 runs from Affordable Housing Statement to the Community Infrastructure Levy form (42 rows)

summary: Grokbot links the current Dartford list (July 2026, in use from 1 July 2026), but it captured only about 10 of the 42 local requirements. It wrongly shows no local requirements for householder and listed building consent applications, and it misstates the HRA trigger, missing the 6km rule that applies to all new dwellings.
